Web Page ============================== MathJax makes it easy to typeset all the math in a web page, and in fact it will do this automatically when it is first loaded unless you configure it not to. So this is one of the easiest actions to perform in MathJax; if your page is static, there is nothing to do but load MathJax. If your page is dynamic, and you may be adding math after the page is loaded, then you will need to tell MathJax to typeset the mathematics once it has been inserted into the page.
